goal: Turn the slice 4 session scenarios from self-consistency tests into validation against ground truth: for every two-pool FPM scenario, after the inventory, send benign FastCGI requests over the container's loopback (no network) to a mounted probe script that writes one plain string session through the writer pool and reads it through the reader pool; record whether the session file appears in the reader's live save_path before the reader request (shared store) and whether the reader decodes it (read back), using ini_get_all/session files rather than ini_get (a shared OPcache folds ini_get across pools). Assert the tool's CVE-2026-115560 shared-store raise holds exactly when the store is really shared and the reader really cannot decode the writer's data. No exploit payloads (no objects), probe data stays inside the disposable container.
